title: The Listening Grove makes 617 images sing
dek: PointCast reviews a huge Midjourney archive reborn as a sharp, swipeable audiovisual instrument
body:
The Listening Grove is not a grid with a soundtrack. Its fourth version turns 617 Midjourney works into a responsive instrument for bells, gongs, color fields, swipes, and unhurried looking.

PointCast Review Lab tested the released experience on desktop and a 390 × 844 mobile viewport, cycled its Tide, Prism, and Ritual scores, changed the auto-view pace, used swipe navigation and haptics, and preserved three interface screenshots from the tested build. The image-fidelity fix is exhibition design rather than a fake enhancement pass: high-resolution derivatives stay inside their useful display size and keep their aspect ratios.

The visible 10ꜩ, five-edition collect path remains a Tezos Mainnet preview. A wallet handoff is not proof of a mint, and this review claims no completed transaction without an operation hash and independent confirmation.
